correctness.rationale: For n=8,9,10,11,12, I independently rebuilt all GP(n,2) shortest-path distances and clique faces of the graph square from the three original edge families, then separately loaded MORSE_CERTIFICATE.json and checked the entire matching: each pair is a codimension-one face/coface, each simplex exactly once matched or critical, and a complete reversed-edge Hasse topological sort is acyclic. Exact face totals were 254,288,342,352,388 and matched/critical partitions 126/2,143/2,170/2,175/2,192/4. Critical-cell counts respectively 0-cell plus one 2-cell, one 1-cell, one 2-cell, one 1-cell, and three 2-cells; no higher critical cells. Forman discrete Morse theorem supplies a CW complex with these cells: a single 0-cell plus k 2-cells gives wedge k S2, and a single 0- and 1-cell gives S1. This is integral homotopy, not an inference from mod-two homology.
